source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.flowers: Groups of 2–4(–8), opening with emerging leaves, white petals 5–6.3 mm
morphology_documented.fruit: Drupes 1.3–2 cm, yellow with red patches or occasionally red

source_scope_note: Species-level and key-level traits distinguished; modern secondary traits stay attributed to their own sources.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: The historical source notes smaller generally tart fruit relative to P. angustifolia
Avoid lumping P. munsoniana into P. rivularis automatically: Diggs discusses doubtful separation, not conclusive synonymy
preservation: Additive research only, species JSON and photo/attribution/gallery assets unchanged
